deduped_items.title: जंतर-मंतर नहीं पहुंच पाए प्रदर्शनकारी, लीडर्स हिरासत में:38 हजार सुरक्षाकर्मी, 10 फीट ऊंचे बैरिकेड्स; पुलिस ने प्रदर्शन कैसे रोका, 7 पॉइंट्स में
deduped_items.summary: दिल्ली पुलिस की सख्ती की वजह से शाम 5 बजे तक कॉकरोच जनता पार्टी के प्रदर्शनकारी जंतर-मंतर तक नहीं पहुंच पाए। पुलिस ने सीजेपी की लीडरशिप अभिजीत दीपके, सौरव दास और आशुतोष रांका को सुबह ही एयरपोर्ट पर हिरासत में ले लिया। पार्टी ने सुबह 10 बजे जंतर-मंतर पर प्रदर्शन बुलाया था। समर्थकों ने यहां पहुंचने की कोशिश भी की, लेकिन कई जगह 3 से 5 लेयर की बैरिकडिंग की वजह से आगे नहीं बढ़ने दिया। अब तक 3500 लोगों को कस्टडी में लिया गया। इस दौरान ममता बनर्जी, अरविंद केजरीवाल को भी हिरासत में लिया गया। पुलिस से झड़प
deduped_items.body_text:
- Hindi News
- National
- Jantar Mantar Protest LIVE | CJP CEC Gyanesh Kumar SIR Row Violence Photos Update; Abhijeet Dipke Rahul Gandhi Vs Delhi Police BJP Congress
LIVEजंतर-मंतर नहीं पहुंच पाए प्रदर्शनकारी, लीडर्स हिरासत में:38 हजार सुरक्षाकर्मी, 10 फीट ऊंचे बैरिकेड्स; पुलिस ने प्रदर्शन कैसे रोका, 7 पॉइंट्स में
- कॉपी लिंक
दिल्ली पुलिस की सख्ती की वजह से शाम 5 बजे तक कॉकरोच जनता पार्टी के प्रदर्शनकारी जंतर-मंतर तक नहीं पहुंच पाए। पुलिस ने सीजेपी की लीडरशिप अभिजीत दीपके, सौरव दास और आशुतोष रांका को सुबह ही एयरपोर्ट पर हिरासत में ले लिया।
पार्टी ने सुबह 10 बजे जंतर-मंतर पर प्रदर्शन बुलाया था। समर्थकों ने यहां पहुंचने की कोशिश भी की, लेकिन कई जगह 3 से 5 लेयर की बैरिकडिंग की वजह से आगे नहीं बढ़ने दिया। अब तक 3500 लोगों को कस्टडी में लिया गया। इस दौरान ममता बनर्जी, अरविंद केजरीवाल को भी हिरासत में लिया गया।
पुलिस से झड़प की एक या दो घटनाएं सामने आईं। प्रदर्शनकारियों ने बैरिकेडिंग भी तोड़ी। आकाशवाणी भवन के पास पत्थर फेंके, जिससे 2 पुलिसकर्मी घायल हो गए।
CJP ने मतदाता सूची में गड़बड़ियों और SIR के विरोध में मुख्य चुनाव आयुक्त ज्ञानेश कुमार के इस्तीफे की मांग को लेकर जंतर-मंतर पर प्रदर्शन का आह्वान किया था।
प्रदर्शन के पहले और बाद की 3 तस्वीरें…
पुलिस ने 'कॉकरोच' का प्रदर्शन कैसे रोका, 7 पॉइंट्स में
1. 38 हजार जवान तैनात: 8 से 12 अक्टूबर तक CAPF की 221 कंपनियां यानी करीब 23 हजार जवान बुलाए गए। इनके अलावा दिल्ली पुलिस के कम से कम 15 हजार कर्मियों की तैनाती की योजना बनाई गई।
2. दिल्ली आने वाली ट्रेनें रद्द, बसों की बुकिंग की जांच: शनिवार को सुबह 4 बजे से दोपहर 2 बजे तक आने वाली 250 ट्रेनें रद्द की गईं। बसों की बुकिंग की जांच शुरू की गई, ताकि पता चल सके कि कौन वाहन किराए पर ले रहा है और कितने लोग दिल्ली आने वाले हैं।
3. छात्रों को रोकने की अपील: यूनिवर्सिटी-कॉलेज प्रमुखों और PG मालिकों से संपर्क कर छात्रों को प्रदर्शन में शामिल होने से रोकने की अपील की गई।
4. मेट्रो स्टेशन बंद, बैरिकेडिंग: 10 अक्टूबर को 45 मेट्रो स्टेशनों पर एंट्री और एग्जिट बंद रखने की व्यवस्था की गई। जंतर-मंतर से पहले ही 10 फीट ऊंचे बैरिकेड लगाए गए। आंसू गैस की गाड़ियां भी तैनात की गईं।
5. दिल्ली के बॉर्डर पर सख्ती: दूसरे राज्यों से आने वाले रास्तों पर जांच बढ़ाई गई। यूपी से लगी पूर्वी दिल्ली और शाहदरा सीमा के साथ राजस्थान से आने वाले रूट पर भी नजर रखी गई। कीलें और बैरिकेड लगाए गए।
6. बॉडीकैम से रिकॉर्डिंग, अस्थायी हिरासत केंद्र की तैयारी: झड़पों की रिकॉर्डिंग के लिए फ्रंटलाइन पर तैनात पुलिसकर्मियों को 150 बॉडीकैम दिए गए। प्रदर्शनकारियों को रखने के लिए स्टेडियम में अस्थायी हिरासत केंद्र बनाए गए।
7. दीपके फ्लाइट से ही हिरासत में, रास्ते में ही कार्यकर्ताओं को रोका: अभिजीत दीपके, आशुतोष रांका और सौरव दास को फ्लाइट से ही हिरासत में लिया गया। CJP कार्यकर्ताओं को जंतर-मंतर पहुंचने से पहले ही पकड़ा गया।

세 줄 요약
팔레스타인, 11월 예정 총선 내년 9월로 연기 
내년 9월 11일 대선과 총선 동시 실시 포고령 
2006년 이후 20년째 총선 못 치러 
인공지능이 자동으로 줄인 '세 줄 요약' 기술을 사용합니다.
전체 내용을 이해하기 위해서는 기사 본문과 함께 읽어야 합니다. 
구글 검색에서 연합뉴스 기사를 우선적으로 보여줍니다.
(요하네스버그=연합뉴스) 나확진 특파원 = 팔레스타인 자치정부가 올해 11월 치르기로 한 총선을 내년 9월로 미루고 대선과 함께 치르겠다고 발표했다.
10일(현지시간) AFP 통신에 따르면, 마무드 아바스 자치정부 수반은 이날 자치정부 수반 선거(대선)와 입법의회 선거(총선)를 내년 9월 11일 동시에 실시하도록 하는 포고령을 발표했다고 팔레스타인 관영 WAFA 통신이 보도했다.
아바스 수반은 지난 7월 총선을 오는 11월 28일로 확정했다는 포고령을 발표한 바 있다.
팔레스타인의 마지막 총선은 20년 전인 2006년 1월에 치러졌다. 당시 이스라엘에 대한 무력 저항을 기치로 내건 무장정파 하마스가 전체 132석의 의석 중 74석을 차지하며 다수당이 됐다.
1년 뒤 하마스는 아바스 수반이 이끄는 파타 정파와의 유혈 충돌 끝에 파타를 몰아내고 가자지구를 장악했다.
이후 팔레스타인 의회는 사실상 마비 상태에 빠졌고, 2018년 말 팔레스타인 헌법재판소에 의해 공식 해산됐다.
올해 90세인 아바스 수반은 2005년 1월 9일 치러진 선거에서 당선됐다. 그의 공식적인 임기는 2009년에 종료됐지만, 이후 수반 선거가 거듭 연기되거나 취소되면서 현재까지 권력을 유지하고 있다.
앞서 후세인 알셰이크 자치정부 부수반은 지난 8일 장노엘 바로 프랑스 외무장관에게 보낸 편지에서 "11월 28일로 예정된 총선 일정의 근거가 됐던 정치적, 안보적, 경제적 여건이 예상과 달리 실현되지 않았다"며 "현 상황에서 선거를 치른다면 포용성, 참여의 자유, 선거 과정의 공정성 등에 영향을 미칠 근본적인 장애물을 마주하게 된다"며 총선 일정 연기를 시사했다고 로이터 통신은 전했다.

Speaking from a Nuremberg courtroom Friday where the trials of World War II Nazi leaders took place, the South Africa-born judge said world leaders have a "legal obligation" ...[more...]

deduped_items.title: 美 타임스스퀘어 전광판, 단돈 30만원에 ‘한글 게시판’ 됐다
deduped_items.summary: “잠실야구장 마지막 해, 물 뿌려드립니다!”최근 도심 번화가 옥외 전광판에 짧은 문구가 흘러나왔다. 서울 잠실을 연고지로 삼는 야구팀 LG트윈스 측이 집행한 광고였다. 올해 말 잠실야구장 철거를 앞두고 홈팬들을 불러모아 워터쇼를 제공하겠다는 안내용이었지만, 해당 전광판은 한국에 위치한 게 아니었다. 미국 뉴욕 한복판 타임스스퀘어에 있다. 광고 말미에 “(미국 야구팀) 미네소타 트윈스 아닙니다”라고 익살스레 적어둔 이유다. 전부 한글로 이뤄진, 한국 사람 아니면 이해할 수 없는 외국발 광고. 구단 관계자는 “요새 떠오르는 바이럴 마케팅 방식을 시도했다”며 “비용이 생각보다 저렴해 결정이 쉬웠다”고 말했다.

2006년 이후 20년째 총선 못 치러 
인공지능이 자동으로 줄인 '세 줄 요약' 기술을 사용합니다.
전체 내용을 이해하기 위해서는 기사 본문과 함께 읽어야 합니다. 
구글 검색에서 연합뉴스 기사를 우선적으로 보여줍니다.
(요하네스버그=연합뉴스) 나확진 특파원 = 팔레스타인 자치정부가 올해 11월 치르기로 한 총선을 내년 9월로 미루고 대선과 함께 치르겠다고 발표했다.
10일(현지시간) AFP 통신에 따르면, 마무드 아바스 자치정부 수반은 이날 자치정부 수반 선거(대선)와 입법의회 선거(총선)를 내년 9월 11일 동시에 실시하도록 하는 포고령을 발표했다고 팔레스타인 관영 WAFA 통신이 보도했다.
아바스 수반은 지난 7월 총선을 오는 11월 28일로 확정했다는 포고령을 발표한 바 있다.
팔레스타인의 마지막 총선은 20년 전인 2006년 1월에 치러졌다. 당시 이스라엘에 대한 무력 저항을 기치로 내건 무장정파 하마스가 전체 132석의 의석 중 74석을 차지하며 다수당이 됐다.
1년 뒤 하마스는 아바스 수반이 이끄는 파타 정파와의 유혈 충돌 끝에 파타를 몰아내고 가자지구를 장악했다.
이후 팔레스타인 의회는 사실상 마비 상태에 빠졌고, 2018년 말 팔레스타인 헌법재판소에 의해 공식 해산됐다.
올해 90세인 아바스 수반은 2005년 1월 9일 치러진 선거에서 당선됐다. 그의 공식적인 임기는 2009년에 종료됐지만, 이후 수반 선거가 거듭 연기되거나 취소되면서 현재까지 권력을 유지하고 있다.
앞서 후세인 알셰이크 자치정부 부수반은 지난 8일 장노엘 바로 프랑스 외무장관에게 보낸 편지에서 "11월 28일로 예정된 총선 일정의 근거가 됐던 정치적, 안보적, 경제적 여건이 예상과 달리 실현되지 않았다"며 "현 상황에서 선거를 치른다면 포용성, 참여의 자유, 선거 과정의 공정성 등에 영향을 미칠 근본적인 장애물을 마주하게 된다"며 총선 일정 연기를 시사했다고 로이터 통신은 전했다.

인공지능이 자동으로 줄인 '세 줄 요약' 기술을 사용합니다.
전체 내용을 이해하기 위해서는 기사 본문과 함께 읽어야 합니다. 
구글 검색에서 연합뉴스 기사를 우선적으로 보여줍니다.
(부산=연합뉴스) 김선호 기자 = 한글날 연휴 둘째 날인 10일 부산 북항 친수공원 인공수로에 머무르는 흑상어 '부캉이'를 보러 온 이는 6만명에 육박했다.
부산시설공단에 따르면 이날 오후 6시 기준 북항 친수공원 방문객은 5만9천명으로 집계됐다. 연휴 첫날인 9일 방문객은 7만4천명이었다.
공단 측이 공식 집계를 시작한 지난달 19일 이후 현재까지 누적 방문객은 127만6천800명이다.
부캉이는 지난달 18일 친수공원 내 인공수로에 나타나 23일째 머물고 있다.
구조 당국은 그동안 2차례에 걸쳐 부캉이를 외해로 보내려는 구조 작업을 진행했으나 실패한 뒤 부캉이가 스스로 나가기를 기다리고 있다.

LIVEजंतर-मंतर नहीं पहुंच पाए प्रदर्शनकारी, लीडर्स हिरासत में:38 हजार सुरक्षाकर्मी, 10 फीट ऊंचे बैरिकेड्स; पुलिस ने प्रदर्शन कैसे रोका, 7 पॉइंट्स में
- कॉपी लिंक
दिल्ली पुलिस की सख्ती की वजह से शाम 5 बजे तक कॉकरोच जनता पार्टी के प्रदर्शनकारी जंतर-मंतर तक नहीं पहुंच पाए। पुलिस ने सीजेपी की लीडरशिप अभिजीत दीपके, सौरव दास और आशुतोष रांका को सुबह ही एयरपोर्ट पर हिरासत में ले लिया।
पार्टी ने सुबह 10 बजे जंतर-मंतर पर प्रदर्शन बुलाया था। समर्थकों ने यहां पहुंचने की कोशिश भी की, लेकिन कई जगह 3 से 5 लेयर की बैरिकडिंग की वजह से आगे नहीं बढ़ने दिया। अब तक 3500 लोगों को कस्टडी में लिया गया। इस दौरान ममता बनर्जी, अरविंद केजरीवाल को भी हिरासत में लिया गया।
पुलिस से झड़प की एक या दो घटनाएं सामने आईं। प्रदर्शनकारियों ने बैरिकेडिंग भी तोड़ी। आकाशवाणी भवन के पास पत्थर फेंके, जिससे 2 पुलिसकर्मी घायल हो गए।
CJP ने मतदाता सूची में गड़बड़ियों और SIR के विरोध में मुख्य चुनाव आयुक्त ज्ञानेश कुमार के इस्तीफे की मांग को लेकर जंतर-मंतर पर प्रदर्शन का आह्वान किया था।
प्रदर्शन के पहले और बाद की 3 तस्वीरें…
पुलिस ने 'कॉकरोच' का प्रदर्शन कैसे रोका, 7 पॉइंट्स में
1. 38 हजार जवान तैनात: 8 से 12 अक्टूबर तक CAPF की 221 कंपनियां यानी करीब 23 हजार जवान बुलाए गए। इनके अलावा दिल्ली पुलिस के कम से कम 15 हजार कर्मियों की तैनाती की योजना बनाई गई।
2. दिल्ली आने वाली ट्रेनें रद्द, बसों की बुकिंग की जांच: शनिवार को सुबह 4 बजे से दोपहर 2 बजे तक आने वाली 250 ट्रेनें रद्द की गईं। बसों की बुकिंग की जांच शुरू की गई, ताकि पता चल सके कि कौन वाहन किराए पर ले रहा है और कितने लोग दिल्ली आने वाले हैं।
3. छात्रों को रोकने की अपील: यूनिवर्सिटी-कॉलेज प्रमुखों और PG मालिकों से संपर्क कर छात्रों को प्रदर्शन में शामिल होने से रोकने की अपील की गई।
4. मेट्रो स्टेशन बंद, बैरिकेडिंग: 10 अक्टूबर को 45 मेट्रो स्टेशनों पर एंट्री और एग्जिट बंद रखने की व्यवस्था की गई। जंतर-मंतर से पहले ही 10 फीट ऊंचे बैरिकेड लगाए गए। आंसू गैस की गाड़ियां भी तैनात की गईं।
5. दिल्ली के बॉर्डर पर सख्ती: दूसरे राज्यों से आने वाले रास्तों पर जांच बढ़ाई गई। यूपी से लगी पूर्वी दिल्ली और शाहदरा सीमा के साथ राजस्थान से आने वाले रूट पर भी नजर रखी गई। कीलें और बैरिकेड लगाए गए।

2006년 이후 20년째 총선 못 치러 
인공지능이 자동으로 줄인 '세 줄 요약' 기술을 사용합니다.
전체 내용을 이해하기 위해서는 기사 본문과 함께 읽어야 합니다. 
구글 검색에서 연합뉴스 기사를 우선적으로 보여줍니다.
(요하네스버그=연합뉴스) 나확진 특파원 = 팔레스타인 자치정부가 올해 11월 치르기로 한 총선을 내년 9월로 미루고 대선과 함께 치르겠다고 발표했다.
10일(현지시간) AFP 통신에 따르면, 마무드 아바스 자치정부 수반은 이날 자치정부 수반 선거(대선)와 입법의회 선거(총선)를 내년 9월 11일 동시에 실시하도록 하는 포고령을 발표했다고 팔레스타인 관영 WAFA 통신이 보도했다.
아바스 수반은 지난 7월 총선을 오는 11월 28일로 확정했다는 포고령을 발표한 바 있다.
팔레스타인의 마지막 총선은 20년 전인 2006년 1월에 치러졌다. 당시 이스라엘에 대한 무력 저항을 기치로 내건 무장정파 하마스가 전체 132석의 의석 중 74석을 차지하며 다수당이 됐다.
1년 뒤 하마스는 아바스 수반이 이끄는 파타 정파와의 유혈 충돌 끝에 파타를 몰아내고 가자지구를 장악했다.
이후 팔레스타인 의회는 사실상 마비 상태에 빠졌고, 2018년 말 팔레스타인 헌법재판소에 의해 공식 해산됐다.
올해 90세인 아바스 수반은 2005년 1월 9일 치러진 선거에서 당선됐다. 그의 공식적인 임기는 2009년에 종료됐지만, 이후 수반 선거가 거듭 연기되거나 취소되면서 현재까지 권력을 유지하고 있다.
앞서 후세인 알셰이크 자치정부 부수반은 지난 8일 장노엘 바로 프랑스 외무장관에게 보낸 편지에서 "11월 28일로 예정된 총선 일정의 근거가 됐던 정치적, 안보적, 경제적 여건이 예상과 달리 실현되지 않았다"며 "현 상황에서 선거를 치른다면 포용성, 참여의 자유, 선거 과정의 공정성 등에 영향을 미칠 근본적인 장애물을 마주하게 된다"며 총선 일정 연기를 시사했다고 로이터 통신은 전했다.
 rao@yna.co.kr

LIVEजंतर-मंतर नहीं पहुंच पाए प्रदर्शनकारी, लीडर्स हिरासत में:38 हजार सुरक्षाकर्मी, 10 फीट ऊंचे बैरिकेड्स; पुलिस ने प्रदर्शन कैसे रोका, 7 पॉइंट्स में
- कॉपी लिंक
दिल्ली पुलिस की सख्ती की वजह से शाम 5 बजे तक कॉकरोच जनता पार्टी के प्रदर्शनकारी जंतर-मंतर तक नहीं पहुंच पाए। पुलिस ने सीजेपी की लीडरशिप अभिजीत दीपके, सौरव दास और आशुतोष रांका को सुबह ही एयरपोर्ट पर हिरासत में ले लिया।
पार्टी ने सुबह 10 बजे जंतर-मंतर पर प्रदर्शन बुलाया था। समर्थकों ने यहां पहुंचने की कोशिश भी की, लेकिन कई जगह 3 से 5 लेयर की बैरिकडिंग की वजह से आगे नहीं बढ़ने दिया। अब तक 3500 लोगों को कस्टडी में लिया गया। इस दौरान ममता बनर्जी, अरविंद केजरीवाल को भी हिरासत में लिया गया।
पुलिस से झड़प की एक या दो घटनाएं सामने आईं। प्रदर्शनकारियों ने बैरिकेडिंग भी तोड़ी। आकाशवाणी भवन के पास पत्थर फेंके, जिससे 2 पुलिसकर्मी घायल हो गए।
CJP ने मतदाता सूची में गड़बड़ियों और SIR के विरोध में मुख्य चुनाव आयुक्त ज्ञानेश कुमार के इस्तीफे की मांग को लेकर जंतर-मंतर पर प्रदर्शन का आह्वान किया था।
प्रदर्शन के पहले और बाद की 3 तस्वीरें…
पुलिस ने 'कॉकरोच' का प्रदर्शन कैसे रोका, 7 पॉइंट्स में
1. 38 हजार जवान तैनात: 8 से 12 अक्टूबर तक CAPF की 221 कंपनियां यानी करीब 23 हजार जवान बुलाए गए। इनके अलावा दिल्ली पुलिस के कम से कम 15 हजार कर्मियों की तैनाती की योजना बनाई गई।
2. दिल्ली आने वाली ट्रेनें रद्द, बसों की बुकिंग की जांच: शनिवार को सुबह 4 बजे से दोपहर 2 बजे तक आने वाली 250 ट्रेनें रद्द की गईं। बसों की बुकिंग की जांच शुरू की गई, ताकि पता चल सके कि कौन वाहन किराए पर ले रहा है और कितने लोग दिल्ली आने वाले हैं।
3. छात्रों को रोकने की अपील: यूनिवर्सिटी-कॉलेज प्रमुखों और PG मालिकों से संपर्क कर छात्रों को प्रदर्शन में शामिल होने से रोकने की अपील की गई।
4. मेट्रो स्टेशन बंद, बैरिकेडिंग: 10 अक्टूबर को 45 मेट्रो स्टेशनों पर एंट्री और एग्जिट बंद रखने की व्यवस्था की गई। जंतर-मंतर से पहले ही 10 फीट ऊंचे बैरिकेड लगाए गए। आंसू गैस की गाड़ियां भी तैनात की गईं।
5. दिल्ली के बॉर्डर पर सख्ती: दूसरे राज्यों से आने वाले रास्तों पर जांच बढ़ाई गई। यूपी से लगी पूर्वी दिल्ली और शाहदरा सीमा के साथ राजस्थान से आने वाले रूट पर भी नजर रखी गई। कीलें और बैरिकेड लगाए गए।
6. बॉडीकैम से रिकॉर्डिंग, अस्थायी हिरासत केंद्र की तैयारी: झड़पों की रिकॉर्डिंग के लिए फ्रंटलाइन पर तैनात पुलिसकर्मियों को 150 बॉडीकैम दिए गए। प्रदर्शनकारियों को रखने के लिए स्टेडियम में अस्थायी हिरासत केंद्र बनाए गए।
7. दीपके फ्लाइट से ही हिरासत में, रास्ते में ही कार्यकर्ताओं को रोका: अभिजीत दीपके, आशुतोष रांका और सौरव दास को फ्लाइट से ही हिरासत में लिया गया। CJP कार्यकर्ताओं को जंतर-मंतर पहुंचने से पहले ही पकड़ा गया।

2006년 이후 20년째 총선 못 치러 
인공지능이 자동으로 줄인 '세 줄 요약' 기술을 사용합니다.
전체 내용을 이해하기 위해서는 기사 본문과 함께 읽어야 합니다. 
구글 검색에서 연합뉴스 기사를 우선적으로 보여줍니다.
(요하네스버그=연합뉴스) 나확진 특파원 = 팔레스타인 자치정부가 올해 11월 치르기로 한 총선을 내년 9월로 미루고 대선과 함께 치르겠다고 발표했다.
10일(현지시간) AFP 통신에 따르면, 마무드 아바스 자치정부 수반은 이날 자치정부 수반 선거(대선)와 입법의회 선거(총선)를 내년 9월 11일 동시에 실시하도록 하는 포고령을 발표했다고 팔레스타인 관영 WAFA 통신이 보도했다.
아바스 수반은 지난 7월 총선을 오는 11월 28일로 확정했다는 포고령을 발표한 바 있다.
팔레스타인의 마지막 총선은 20년 전인 2006년 1월에 치러졌다. 당시 이스라엘에 대한 무력 저항을 기치로 내건 무장정파 하마스가 전체 132석의 의석 중 74석을 차지하며 다수당이 됐다.
1년 뒤 하마스는 아바스 수반이 이끄는 파타 정파와의 유혈 충돌 끝에 파타를 몰아내고 가자지구를 장악했다.
이후 팔레스타인 의회는 사실상 마비 상태에 빠졌고, 2018년 말 팔레스타인 헌법재판소에 의해 공식 해산됐다.
올해 90세인 아바스 수반은 2005년 1월 9일 치러진 선거에서 당선됐다. 그의 공식적인 임기는 2009년에 종료됐지만, 이후 수반 선거가 거듭 연기되거나 취소되면서 현재까지 권력을 유지하고 있다.
앞서 후세인 알셰이크 자치정부 부수반은 지난 8일 장노엘 바로 프랑스 외무장관에게 보낸 편지에서 "11월 28일로 예정된 총선 일정의 근거가 됐던 정치적, 안보적, 경제적 여건이 예상과 달리 실현되지 않았다"며 "현 상황에서 선거를 치른다면 포용성, 참여의 자유, 선거 과정의 공정성 등에 영향을 미칠 근본적인 장애물을 마주하게 된다"며 총선 일정 연기를 시사했다고 로이터 통신은 전했다.

deduped_items.summary: “잠실야구장 마지막 해, 물 뿌려드립니다!”최근 도심 번화가 옥외 전광판에 짧은 문구가 흘러나왔다. 서울 잠실을 연고지로 삼는 야구팀 LG트윈스 측이 집행한 광고였다. 올해 말 잠실야구장 철거를 앞두고 홈팬들을 불러모아 워터쇼를 제공하겠다는 안내용이었지만, 해당 전광판은 한국에 위치한 게 아니었다. 미국 뉴욕 한복판 타임스스퀘어에 있다. 광고 말미에 “(미국 야구팀) 미네소타 트윈스 아닙니다”라고 익살스레 적어둔 이유다. 전부 한글로 이뤄진, 한국 사람 아니면 이해할 수 없는 외국발 광고. 구단 관계자는 “요새 떠오르는 바이럴 마케팅 방식을 시도했다”며 “비용이 생각보다 저렴해 결정이 쉬웠다”고 말했다.

LIVEजंतर-मंतर नहीं पहुंच पाए प्रदर्शनकारी, लीडर्स हिरासत में:38 हजार सुरक्षाकर्मी, 10 फीट ऊंचे बैरिकेड्स; पुलिस ने प्रदर्शन कैसे रोका, 7 पॉइंट्स में
- कॉपी लिंक
दिल्ली पुलिस की सख्ती की वजह से शाम 5 बजे तक कॉकरोच जनता पार्टी के प्रदर्शनकारी जंतर-मंतर तक नहीं पहुंच पाए। पुलिस ने सीजेपी की लीडरशिप अभिजीत दीपके, सौरव दास और आशुतोष रांका को सुबह ही एयरपोर्ट पर हिरासत में ले लिया।
पार्टी ने सुबह 10 बजे जंतर-मंतर पर प्रदर्शन बुलाया था। समर्थकों ने यहां पहुंचने की कोशिश भी की, लेकिन कई जगह 3 से 5 लेयर की बैरिकडिंग की वजह से आगे नहीं बढ़ने दिया। अब तक 3500 लोगों को कस्टडी में लिया गया। इस दौरान ममता बनर्जी, अरविंद केजरीवाल को भी हिरासत में लिया गया।
पुलिस से झड़प की एक या दो घटनाएं सामने आईं। प्रदर्शनकारियों ने बैरिकेडिंग भी तोड़ी। आकाशवाणी भवन के पास पत्थर फेंके, जिससे 2 पुलिसकर्मी घायल हो गए।
CJP ने मतदाता सूची में गड़बड़ियों और SIR के विरोध में मुख्य चुनाव आयुक्त ज्ञानेश कुमार के इस्तीफे की मांग को लेकर जंतर-मंतर पर प्रदर्शन का आह्वान किया था।
प्रदर्शन के पहले और बाद की 3 तस्वीरें…
पुलिस ने 'कॉकरोच' का प्रदर्शन कैसे रोका, 7 पॉइंट्स में
1. 38 हजार जवान तैनात: 8 से 12 अक्टूबर तक CAPF की 221 कंपनियां यानी करीब 23 हजार जवान बुलाए गए। इनके अलावा दिल्ली पुलिस के कम से कम 15 हजार कर्मियों की तैनाती की योजना बनाई गई।
2. दिल्ली आने वाली ट्रेनें रद्द, बसों की बुकिंग की जांच: शनिवार को सुबह 4 बजे से दोपहर 2 बजे तक आने वाली 250 ट्रेनें रद्द की गईं। बसों की बुकिंग की जांच शुरू की गई, ताकि पता चल सके कि कौन वाहन किराए पर ले रहा है और कितने लोग दिल्ली आने वाले हैं।
3. छात्रों को रोकने की अपील: यूनिवर्सिटी-कॉलेज प्रमुखों और PG मालिकों से संपर्क कर छात्रों को प्रदर्शन में शामिल होने से रोकने की अपील की गई।
4. मेट्रो स्टेशन बंद, बैरिकेडिंग: 10 अक्टूबर को 45 मेट्रो स्टेशनों पर एंट्री और एग्जिट बंद रखने की व्यवस्था की गई। जंतर-मंतर से पहले ही 10 फीट ऊंचे बैरिकेड लगाए गए। आंसू गैस की गाड़ियां भी तैनात की गईं।
5. दिल्ली के बॉर्डर पर सख्ती: दूसरे राज्यों से आने वाले रास्तों पर जांच बढ़ाई गई। यूपी से लगी पूर्वी दिल्ली और शाहदरा सीमा के साथ राजस्थान से आने वाले रूट पर भी नजर रखी गई। कीलें और बैरिकेड लगाए गए।
6. बॉडीकैम से रिकॉर्डिंग, अस्थायी हिरासत केंद्र की तैयारी: झड़पों की रिकॉर्डिंग के लिए फ्रंटलाइन पर तैनात पुलिसकर्मियों को 150 बॉडीकैम दिए गए। प्रदर्शनकारियों को रखने के लिए स्टेडियम में अस्थायी हिरासत केंद्र बनाए गए।
7. दीपके फ्लाइट से ही हिरासत में, रास्ते में ही कार्यकर्ताओं को रोका: अभिजीत दीपके, आशुतोष रांका और सौरव दास को फ्लाइट से ही हिरासत में लिया गया। CJP कार्यकर्ताओं को जंतर-मंतर पहुंचने से पहले ही पकड़ा गया।
लाइव अपडेट्स
- कॉपी लिंक
महाराष्ट्र के नासिक में मुख्य चुनाव आयुक्त ज्ञानेश कुमार के इस्तीफे की मांग और SIR के विरोध में मशाल जुलूस निकाला गया। कांग्रेस, कम्युनिस्ट पार्टी, सीजेपी, आईएसआईएफ और विभिन्न छात्र संगठनों के कार्यकर्ताओं और समर्थकों ने इस विरोध प्रदर्शन में भाग लिया।
- कॉपी लिंक
- कॉपी लिंक
- कॉपी लिंक
DMRC ने कहा कि सुरक्षा कारणों से शुक्रवार रात 9:00 बजे से बंद किए गए 45 मेट्रो स्टेशन आज रात 10:00 बजे (10 अक्टूबर) तक बंद रहेंगे। सुरक्षा एजेंसियां स्थिति की समीक्षा करेंगी और अपडेट साझा किए जाएंगे।
- कॉपी लिंक
कांग्रेस सांसद पवन खेड़ा ने कहा- आप देख रहे हैं कि पिछले पांच दिनों से हमारे साथ क्या हो रहा है। वे इसे और आगे बढ़ा रहे हैं। आज उन्होंने वकीलों को नहीं बख्शा, पत्रकारों को नहीं बख्शा, किसी को नहीं बख्शा। यह आपातकाल है। पुलिस गुरुद्वारे में घुस गई।
- कॉपी लिंक
पुणे पुलिस ने लगभग 80 से 100 प्रदर्शनकारियों को हिरासत में लिया और उन्हें लश्कर पुलिस स्टेशन ले गई। पुलिस के अनुसार, हिरासत में लिए गए छात्रों को कुछ घंटों बाद रिहा कर दिया जाएगा।
- कॉपी लिंक
कांग्रेस सांसद दीपेंद्र हुड्डा ने कहा- जिस तरह से पुलिस लोगों को हिरासत में ले रही है, उससे पूरे देश में तानाशाही का माहौल बन रहा है। आप किस तरह का लोकतंत्र चला रहे हैं? पुलिस लोगों के घरों में जाकर उन्हें परेशान कर रही है।
- कॉपी लिंक
- कॉपी लिंक
मुंबई के अगस्त क्रांति मैदान में प्रदर्शन कर रहे करीब 400 लोगों को पुलिस ने हिरासत में ले लिया है। ये लोग दिल्ली में हो रहे विरोध प्रदर्शन के समर्थन में उतरे थे।

LIVEजंतर-मंतर नहीं पहुंच पाए प्रदर्शनकारी, लीडर्स हिरासत में:38 हजार सुरक्षाकर्मी, 10 फीट ऊंचे बैरिकेड्स; पुलिस ने प्रदर्शन कैसे रोका, 7 पॉइंट्स में
- कॉपी लिंक
दिल्ली पुलिस की सख्ती की वजह से शाम 5 बजे तक कॉकरोच जनता पार्टी के प्रदर्शनकारी जंतर-मंतर तक नहीं पहुंच पाए। पुलिस ने सीजेपी की लीडरशिप अभिजीत दीपके, सौरव दास और आशुतोष रांका को सुबह ही एयरपोर्ट पर हिरासत में ले लिया।
पार्टी ने सुबह 10 बजे जंतर-मंतर पर प्रदर्शन बुलाया था। समर्थकों ने यहां पहुंचने की कोशिश भी की, लेकिन कई जगह 3 से 5 लेयर की बैरिकडिंग की वजह से आगे नहीं बढ़ने दिया। अब तक 3500 लोगों को कस्टडी में लिया गया। इस दौरान ममता बनर्जी, अरविंद केजरीवाल को भी हिरासत में लिया गया।
पुलिस से झड़प की एक या दो घटनाएं सामने आईं। प्रदर्शनकारियों ने बैरिकेडिंग भी तोड़ी। आकाशवाणी भवन के पास पत्थर फेंके, जिससे 2 पुलिसकर्मी घायल हो गए।
CJP ने मतदाता सूची में गड़बड़ियों और SIR के विरोध में मुख्य चुनाव आयुक्त ज्ञानेश कुमार के इस्तीफे की मांग को लेकर जंतर-मंतर पर प्रदर्शन का आह्वान किया था।
प्रदर्शन के पहले और बाद की 3 तस्वीरें…
पुलिस ने 'कॉकरोच' का प्रदर्शन कैसे रोका, 7 पॉइंट्स में
1. 38 हजार जवान तैनात: 8 से 12 अक्टूबर तक CAPF की 221 कंपनियां यानी करीब 23 हजार जवान बुलाए गए। इनके अलावा दिल्ली पुलिस के कम से कम 15 हजार कर्मियों की तैनाती की योजना बनाई गई।
2. दिल्ली आने वाली ट्रेनें रद्द, बसों की बुकिंग की जांच: शनिवार को सुबह 4 बजे से दोपहर 2 बजे तक आने वाली 250 ट्रेनें रद्द की गईं। बसों की बुकिंग की जांच शुरू की गई, ताकि पता चल सके कि कौन वाहन किराए पर ले रहा है और कितने लोग दिल्ली आने वाले हैं।
3. छात्रों को रोकने की अपील: यूनिवर्सिटी-कॉलेज प्रमुखों और PG मालिकों से संपर्क कर छात्रों को प्रदर्शन में शामिल होने से रोकने की अपील की गई।
4. मेट्रो स्टेशन बंद, बैरिकेडिंग: 10 अक्टूबर को 45 मेट्रो स्टेशनों पर एंट्री और एग्जिट बंद रखने की व्यवस्था की गई। जंतर-मंतर से पहले ही 10 फीट ऊंचे बैरिकेड लगाए गए। आंसू गैस की गाड़ियां भी तैनात की गईं।
5. दिल्ली के बॉर्डर पर सख्ती: दूसरे राज्यों से आने वाले रास्तों पर जांच बढ़ाई गई। यूपी से लगी पूर्वी दिल्ली और शाहदरा सीमा के साथ राजस्थान से आने वाले रूट पर भी नजर रखी गई। कीलें और बैरिकेड लगाए गए।
6. बॉडीकैम से रिकॉर्डिंग, अस्थायी हिरासत केंद्र की तैयारी: झड़पों की रिकॉर्डिंग के लिए फ्रंटलाइन पर तैनात पुलिसकर्मियों को 150 बॉडीकैम दिए गए। प्रदर्शनकारियों को रखने के लिए स्टेडियम में अस्थायी हिरासत केंद्र बनाए गए।
7. दीपके फ्लाइट से ही हिरासत में, रास्ते में ही कार्यकर्ताओं को रोका: अभिजीत दीपके, आशुतोष रांका और सौरव दास को फ्लाइट से ही हिरासत में लिया गया। CJP कार्यकर्ताओं को जंतर-मंतर पहुंचने से पहले ही पकड़ा गया।
लाइव अपडेट्स
- कॉपी लिंक
महाराष्ट्र के नासिक में मुख्य चुनाव आयुक्त ज्ञानेश कुमार के इस्तीफे की मांग और SIR के विरोध में मशाल जुलूस निकाला गया। कांग्रेस, कम्युनिस्ट पार्टी, सीजेपी, आईएसआईएफ और विभिन्न छात्र संगठनों के कार्यकर्ताओं और समर्थकों ने इस विरोध प्रदर्शन में भाग लिया।
- कॉपी लिंक
- कॉपी लिंक
- कॉपी लिंक
DMRC ने कहा कि सुरक्षा कारणों से शुक्रवार रात 9:00 बजे से बंद किए गए 45 मेट्रो स्टेशन आज रात 10:00 बजे (10 अक्टूबर) तक बंद रहेंगे। सुरक्षा एजेंसियां स्थिति की समीक्षा करेंगी और अपडेट साझा किए जाएंगे।
- कॉपी लिंक
कांग्रेस सांसद पवन खेड़ा ने कहा- आप देख रहे हैं कि पिछले पांच दिनों से हमारे साथ क्या हो रहा है। वे इसे और आगे बढ़ा रहे हैं। आज उन्होंने वकीलों को नहीं बख्शा, पत्रकारों को नहीं बख्शा, किसी को नहीं बख्शा। यह आपातकाल है। पुलिस गुरुद्वारे में घुस गई।
- कॉपी लिंक
पुणे पुलिस ने लगभग 80 से 100 प्रदर्शनकारियों को हिरासत में लिया और उन्हें लश्कर पुलिस स्टेशन ले गई। पुलिस के अनुसार, हिरासत में लिए गए छात्रों को कुछ घंटों बाद रिहा कर दिया जाएगा।
- कॉपी लिंक
कांग्रेस सांसद दीपेंद्र हुड्डा ने कहा- जिस तरह से पुलिस लोगों को हिरासत में ले रही है, उससे पूरे देश में तानाशाही का माहौल बन रहा है। आप किस तरह का लोकतंत्र चला रहे हैं? पुलिस लोगों के घरों में जाकर उन्हें परेशान कर रही है।
- कॉपी लिंक

내년 9월 11일 대선과 총선 동시 실시 포고령 
2006년 이후 20년째 총선 못 치러 
인공지능이 자동으로 줄인 '세 줄 요약' 기술을 사용합니다.
전체 내용을 이해하기 위해서는 기사 본문과 함께 읽어야 합니다. 
구글 검색에서 연합뉴스 기사를 우선적으로 보여줍니다.
(요하네스버그=연합뉴스) 나확진 특파원 = 팔레스타인 자치정부가 올해 11월 치르기로 한 총선을 내년 9월로 미루고 대선과 함께 치르겠다고 발표했다.
10일(현지시간) AFP 통신에 따르면, 마무드 아바스 자치정부 수반은 이날 자치정부 수반 선거(대선)와 입법의회 선거(총선)를 내년 9월 11일 동시에 실시하도록 하는 포고령을 발표했다고 팔레스타인 관영 WAFA 통신이 보도했다.
아바스 수반은 지난 7월 총선을 오는 11월 28일로 확정했다는 포고령을 발표한 바 있다.
팔레스타인의 마지막 총선은 20년 전인 2006년 1월에 치러졌다. 당시 이스라엘에 대한 무력 저항을 기치로 내건 무장정파 하마스가 전체 132석의 의석 중 74석을 차지하며 다수당이 됐다.
1년 뒤 하마스는 아바스 수반이 이끄는 파타 정파와의 유혈 충돌 끝에 파타를 몰아내고 가자지구를 장악했다.
이후 팔레스타인 의회는 사실상 마비 상태에 빠졌고, 2018년 말 팔레스타인 헌법재판소에 의해 공식 해산됐다.
올해 90세인 아바스 수반은 2005년 1월 9일 치러진 선거에서 당선됐다. 그의 공식적인 임기는 2009년에 종료됐지만, 이후 수반 선거가 거듭 연기되거나 취소되면서 현재까지 권력을 유지하고 있다.
앞서 후세인 알셰이크 자치정부 부수반은 지난 8일 장노엘 바로 프랑스 외무장관에게 보낸 편지에서 "11월 28일로 예정된 총선 일정의 근거가 됐던 정치적, 안보적, 경제적 여건이 예상과 달리 실현되지 않았다"며 "현 상황에서 선거를 치른다면 포용성, 참여의 자유, 선거 과정의 공정성 등에 영향을 미칠 근본적인 장애물을 마주하게 된다"며 총선 일정 연기를 시사했다고 로이터 통신은 전했다.

인공지능이 자동으로 줄인 '세 줄 요약' 기술을 사용합니다.
전체 내용을 이해하기 위해서는 기사 본문과 함께 읽어야 합니다. 
구글 검색에서 연합뉴스 기사를 우선적으로 보여줍니다.
(요하네스버그=연합뉴스) 나확진 특파원 = 팔레스타인 자치정부가 올해 11월 치르기로 한 총선을 내년 9월로 미루고 대선과 함께 치르겠다고 발표했다.
10일(현지시간) AFP 통신에 따르면, 마무드 아바스 자치정부 수반은 이날 자치정부 수반 선거(대선)와 입법의회 선거(총선)를 내년 9월 11일 동시에 실시하도록 하는 포고령을 발표했다고 팔레스타인 관영 WAFA 통신이 보도했다.
아바스 수반은 지난 7월 총선을 오는 11월 28일로 확정했다는 포고령을 발표한 바 있다.
팔레스타인의 마지막 총선은 20년 전인 2006년 1월에 치러졌다. 당시 이스라엘에 대한 무력 저항을 기치로 내건 무장정파 하마스가 전체 132석의 의석 중 74석을 차지하며 다수당이 됐다.
1년 뒤 하마스는 아바스 수반이 이끄는 파타 정파와의 유혈 충돌 끝에 파타를 몰아내고 가자지구를 장악했다.
이후 팔레스타인 의회는 사실상 마비 상태에 빠졌고, 2018년 말 팔레스타인 헌법재판소에 의해 공식 해산됐다.
올해 90세인 아바스 수반은 2005년 1월 9일 치러진 선거에서 당선됐다. 그의 공식적인 임기는 2009년에 종료됐지만, 이후 수반 선거가 거듭 연기되거나 취소되면서 현재까지 권력을 유지하고 있다.
앞서 후세인 알셰이크 자치정부 부수반은 지난 8일 장노엘 바로 프랑스 외무장관에게 보낸 편지에서 "11월 28일로 예정된 총선 일정의 근거가 됐던 정치적, 안보적, 경제적 여건이 예상과 달리 실현되지 않았다"며 "현 상황에서 선거를 치른다면 포용성, 참여의 자유, 선거 과정의 공정성 등에 영향을 미칠 근본적인 장애물을 마주하게 된다"며 총선 일정 연기를 시사했다고 로이터 통신은 전했다.
 rao@yna.co.kr

LIVEजंतर-मंतर नहीं पहुंच पाए प्रदर्शनकारी, लीडर्स हिरासत में:38 हजार सुरक्षाकर्मी, 10 फीट ऊंचे बैरिकेड्स; पुलिस ने प्रदर्शन कैसे रोका, 7 पॉइंट्स में
- कॉपी लिंक
दिल्ली पुलिस की सख्ती की वजह से शाम 5 बजे तक कॉकरोच जनता पार्टी के प्रदर्शनकारी जंतर-मंतर तक नहीं पहुंच पाए। पुलिस ने सीजेपी की लीडरशिप अभिजीत दीपके, सौरव दास और आशुतोष रांका को सुबह ही एयरपोर्ट पर हिरासत में ले लिया।
पार्टी ने सुबह 10 बजे जंतर-मंतर पर प्रदर्शन बुलाया था। समर्थकों ने यहां पहुंचने की कोशिश भी की, लेकिन कई जगह 3 से 5 लेयर की बैरिकडिंग की वजह से आगे नहीं बढ़ने दिया। अब तक 3500 लोगों को कस्टडी में लिया गया। इस दौरान ममता बनर्जी, अरविंद केजरीवाल को भी हिरासत में लिया गया।
पुलिस से झड़प की एक या दो घटनाएं सामने आईं। प्रदर्शनकारियों ने बैरिकेडिंग भी तोड़ी। आकाशवाणी भवन के पास पत्थर फेंके, जिससे 2 पुलिसकर्मी घायल हो गए।
CJP ने मतदाता सूची में गड़बड़ियों और SIR के विरोध में मुख्य चुनाव आयुक्त ज्ञानेश कुमार के इस्तीफे की मांग को लेकर जंतर-मंतर पर प्रदर्शन का आह्वान किया था।
प्रदर्शन के पहले और बाद की 3 तस्वीरें…
पुलिस ने 'कॉकरोच' का प्रदर्शन कैसे रोका, 7 पॉइंट्स में
1. 38 हजार जवान तैनात: 8 से 12 अक्टूबर तक CAPF की 221 कंपनियां यानी करीब 23 हजार जवान बुलाए गए। इनके अलावा दिल्ली पुलिस के कम से कम 15 हजार कर्मियों की तैनाती की योजना बनाई गई।
2. दिल्ली आने वाली ट्रेनें रद्द, बसों की बुकिंग की जांच: शनिवार को सुबह 4 बजे से दोपहर 2 बजे तक आने वाली 250 ट्रेनें रद्द की गईं। बसों की बुकिंग की जांच शुरू की गई, ताकि पता चल सके कि कौन वाहन किराए पर ले रहा है और कितने लोग दिल्ली आने वाले हैं।
3. छात्रों को रोकने की अपील: यूनिवर्सिटी-कॉलेज प्रमुखों और PG मालिकों से संपर्क कर छात्रों को प्रदर्शन में शामिल होने से रोकने की अपील की गई।
4. मेट्रो स्टेशन बंद, बैरिकेडिंग: 10 अक्टूबर को 45 मेट्रो स्टेशनों पर एंट्री और एग्जिट बंद रखने की व्यवस्था की गई। जंतर-मंतर से पहले ही 10 फीट ऊंचे बैरिकेड लगाए गए। आंसू गैस की गाड़ियां भी तैनात की गईं।
5. दिल्ली के बॉर्डर पर सख्ती: दूसरे राज्यों से आने वाले रास्तों पर जांच बढ़ाई गई। यूपी से लगी पूर्वी दिल्ली और शाहदरा सीमा के साथ राजस्थान से आने वाले रूट पर भी नजर रखी गई। कीलें और बैरिकेड लगाए गए।
6. बॉडीकैम से रिकॉर्डिंग, अस्थायी हिरासत केंद्र की तैयारी: झड़पों की रिकॉर्डिंग के लिए फ्रंटलाइन पर तैनात पुलिसकर्मियों को 150 बॉडीकैम दिए गए। प्रदर्शनकारियों को रखने के लिए स्टेडियम में अस्थायी हिरासत केंद्र बनाए गए।
7. दीपके फ्लाइट से ही हिरासत में, रास्ते में ही कार्यकर्ताओं को रोका: अभिजीत दीपके, आशुतोष रांका और सौरव दास को फ्लाइट से ही हिरासत में लिया गया। CJP कार्यकर्ताओं को जंतर-मंतर पहुंचने से पहले ही पकड़ा गया।
लाइव अपडेट्स
- कॉपी लिंक
महाराष्ट्र के नासिक में मुख्य चुनाव आयुक्त ज्ञानेश कुमार के इस्तीफे की मांग और SIR के विरोध में मशाल जुलूस निकाला गया। कांग्रेस, कम्युनिस्ट पार्टी, सीजेपी, आईएसआईएफ और विभिन्न छात्र संगठनों के कार्यकर्ताओं और समर्थकों ने इस विरोध प्रदर्शन में भाग लिया।
- कॉपी लिंक
- कॉपी लिंक
- कॉपी लिंक
DMRC ने कहा कि सुरक्षा कारणों से शुक्रवार रात 9:00 बजे से बंद किए गए 45 मेट्रो स्टेशन आज रात 10:00 बजे (10 अक्टूबर) तक बंद रहेंगे। सुरक्षा एजेंसियां स्थिति की समीक्षा करेंगी और अपडेट साझा किए जाएंगे।
- कॉपी लिंक
कांग्रेस सांसद पवन खेड़ा ने कहा- आप देख रहे हैं कि पिछले पांच दिनों से हमारे साथ क्या हो रहा है। वे इसे और आगे बढ़ा रहे हैं। आज उन्होंने वकीलों को नहीं बख्शा, पत्रकारों को नहीं बख्शा, किसी को नहीं बख्शा। यह आपातकाल है। पुलिस गुरुद्वारे में घुस गई।
- कॉपी लिंक
पुणे पुलिस ने लगभग 80 से 100 प्रदर्शनकारियों को हिरासत में लिया और उन्हें लश्कर पुलिस स्टेशन ले गई। पुलिस के अनुसार, हिरासत में लिए गए छात्रों को कुछ घंटों बाद रिहा कर दिया जाएगा।
- कॉपी लिंक
कांग्रेस सांसद दीपेंद्र हुड्डा ने कहा- जिस तरह से पुलिस लोगों को हिरासत में ले रही है, उससे पूरे देश में तानाशाही का माहौल बन रहा है। आप किस तरह का लोकतंत्र चला रहे हैं? पुलिस लोगों के घरों में जाकर उन्हें परेशान कर रही है।
- कॉपी लिंक
- कॉपी लिंक
मुंबई के अगस्त क्रांति मैदान में प्रदर्शन कर रहे करीब 400 लोगों को पुलिस ने हिरासत में ले लिया है। ये लोग दिल्ली में हो रहे विरोध प्रदर्शन के समर्थन में उतरे थे।

deduped_items.title: 大阪でだんじり横転相次ぐ 「たかり」役の2人が死亡、計16人けが
deduped_items.body_text:
大阪でだんじり横転相次ぐ 「たかり」役の2人が死亡、計16人けが
新谷千布美 武井風花 花野雄太
大阪府内各地で「だんじり祭り」が開かれた10日、巡行中のだんじりの横転が相次いだ。府警によると、泉佐野市と泉大津市でそれぞれ、右折しようとした際に倒れた。男性計2人が亡くなったほか、祭りの関係者計16人が重軽傷を負ったという。
府警によると、横転はいずれも、勢いよく曲がる見せ場「やりまわし」の際に起きた。泉佐野市長滝の交差点では午前11時ごろ、だんじりが倒れたという。
10～50代の男性8人が病院に運ばれ、下敷きになった会社役員の奥貴博さん（51）=泉佐野市=の死亡が確認された。奥さんは、だんじりのバランスを取る役「たかり」を務めていたという。
午後1時20分ごろには、泉大津市宮町の交差点で祭りの関係者から「だんじりが転倒し、男性が下敷きになった」と119番通報があった。
泉大津署によると、たかり役だった会社員の近藤真吾さん（48）=和泉市=が死亡した。10～60代の男性計9人も病院で治療を受けている。命に別条はなく、一般の観覧客の巻き込みはなかったという。

deduped_items.title: 「バイトル」会員メールアドレス388万件が流出か 不正アクセスで
deduped_items.body_text:
「バイトル」会員メールアドレス388万件が流出か 不正アクセスで
比嘉太一
アルバイト求人サイト「バイトル」や「バイトルNEXT」などを運営するディップ（東京都港区）は9日、両サイトの会員のメールアドレスが最大で約388万件流出した可能性があると発表した。
流出したのはメールアドレスだけ。氏名や電話番号、パスワード、クレジットカード情報は含まれていないという。
ディップの発表によると、6日にサイトの一部機能で海外からの不正アクセスが確認されたという。システムの仕様の不備を突かれたとしている。
ディップは、会員情報のネット上への流出や不正利用は確認されていないと説明している。個人情報保護委員会などに報告し、警察にも相談したという。

deduped_items.title: 天皇、皇后両陛下が即位後初の青森県訪問 国スポ開会式で黙禱
deduped_items.body_text:
天皇、皇后両陛下が即位後初の青森県訪問 国スポ開会式で黙禱
編集委員・島康彦
第80回国民スポーツ大会の総合開会式が10日、天皇、皇后両陛下を迎え、青森市で開かれた。式典では熊本地震や千葉豪雨など各地で相次ぐ災害の犠牲者に黙禱（もくとう）がささげられた。天皇陛下はおことばで「被災された皆さんが、一日も早く安心して暮らせる日常が戻りますよう、復旧・復興が進むことを心から願っております」と述べた。
国民スポーツ大会の青森県開催は49年ぶり。両陛下の同県訪問は令和初とあって、青森空港から移動する沿道には多くの県民が待ち受けた。
開会式で、両陛下は選手の入場を見守り、拍手を送った。10日夜には、青森市内のホテルで大会関係者と懇談した。スポーツクライミング競技青森県代表の関川愛音（めろでぃ）選手は、2028年ロサンゼルス五輪でメダルを獲得して「（両陛下と）また再会できるよう頑張ります」と伝えると、天皇陛下は「楽しみにしています」と声をかけた。

deduped_items.title: ソウルで日韓交流おまつり マグロ解体ショーなどで「食」アピール
deduped_items.body_text:
毎年恒例の日本と韓国の文化交流イベント「日韓交流おまつり2026」が10日、ソウル市内で開かれ、過去最多となる6万8000人が訪れた。長崎県産マグロの解体ショーが披露されるなど、日本の「食」を紹介するブースには多くの人が集まった。
イベントでは、日本舞踊と韓国の伝統芸能「パンソリ」の共演などが披露され日韓交流をアピール。観光や自動車業界などの企業のほか、韓国政府が水産物の輸入規制を続けている福島などを含む15道県がブースを出展した。各地の魅力や東日本大震災からの復興状況を伝え、にぎりずしを振る舞った農林水産省のブースには長い列ができた。
解体したてのマグロを試食した小学6年、パク・ソチャンさん（12）は、「口の中でとろけました。その場でさばかれたので、よりおいしかったです」と笑顔を見せた。【ソウル川口峻】

deduped_items.title: 横浜がジャズ一色に 市内30会場で演奏披露 11日まで
deduped_items.body_text:
横浜の街からジャズの魅力を発信するフェスティバル「横濱ジャズプロムナード」（ジャズプロ）が10日、横浜市内の各所で始まった。プロ、アマチュア計約1700人の演奏で、街中がジャズ一色に染まる。11日まで。
ジャズプロは「街全体をステージに」を合言葉に、横浜の秋を代表するイベントとして33年目の開催。ホールや街角など、約30会場で演奏が披露される。実行委は2日間で約10万人の来場を見込む。
桜木町駅周辺では、至る所で「オー・シャンゼリゼ」のジャズアレンジなどの音色が響いた。アマチュアバンドが演奏する「街角ライブ」には中野雅子さん（58）と村山小百合さん（47）がユニットで出演。中野さんは「これだけのお客さんに聞いてもらえてありがたい」、村山さんも「めったにないこと」と話した。【入学佳成】

deduped_items.title: 息詰まる投手戦、度会の「本能の一発」でDeNAがCS先勝
deduped_items.body_text:
○D2―1巨●（10日・東京ドーム）
巨人・井上温大、DeNA・東克樹の両エース左腕の投げ合いとなった投手戦。一回に1点ずつ奪った後は、双方「0」を並べるという息詰まる展開の中、次の1点を取ったのはDeNAだった。度会隆輝が決勝ソロとなる「本能」の一発を放った。
同点で迎えた九回1死。巨人の守護神・マルティネスの高めの直球を思い切りよく振り抜いた。打球は右翼席方向へ。入ったか、どうか――。ギリギリでスタンドインとなり、三塁側と左翼席に陣取ったDeNAファンから大きな歓声が起こった。
度会は試合中、戸柱恭孝から…

deduped_items.title: 息詰まる投手戦、度会の「本能の一発」でDeNAがCS先勝
deduped_items.body_text:
○D2―1巨●（10日・東京ドーム）
巨人・井上温大、DeNA・東克樹の両エース左腕の投げ合いとなった投手戦。一回に1点ずつ奪った後は、双方「0」を並べるという息詰まる展開の中、次の1点を取ったのはDeNAだった。度会隆輝が決勝ソロとなる「本能」の一発を放った。
同点で迎えた九回1死。巨人の守護神・マルティネスの高めの直球を思い切りよく振り抜いた。打球は右翼席方向へ。入ったか、どうか――。ギリギリでスタンドインとなり、三塁側と左翼席に陣取ったDeNAファンから大きな歓声が起こった。
度会は試合中、戸柱恭孝から「本能で打ってこい」とアドバイスを受けていた。凡退が続いて1番の役目を果たせず、助言を求めたのが生きた。
戸柱は「（度会は）来たボールに対していい入り方ができるのが強み。考えていたら、良いところを生かし切れない」と感じ、「本能で――」と伝えたという。これが24歳の値千金の本塁打につながった。
DeNAがクライマックスシリーズ（CS）で巨人と対戦するのは2024年のファイナルステージ、25年のファーストステージに続いて3年連続。いずれも第1戦をものにして突破している。特に今季と同じレギュラーシーズン71勝69敗3分けの3位だった24年はCSを勝ち抜いて一気に日本シリーズも制し、「下克上」と呼ばれた。その再現へ向けて一つ歩みを進めた。【村社拓信】

deduped_items.body_text:
A justiça italiana marcou para o fim de outubro uma nova audiência para reavaliar o pedido de extradição da ex-deputada Carla Zambelli (PL-SP) para cumprir a pena pela condenação no caso da perseguição armada contra um homem pelas ruas de São Paulo.
Em julho, a Justiça da Itália anulou a extradição e determinou que o pedido apresentado pelo Brasil seja submetido a um novo julgamento, voltando à fase inicial.
A Justiça da Itália descartou a tese de perseguição política, que foi alegada pela defesa de Zambelli. Mas entendeu ser necessária a apresentação de mais garantias do governo brasileiro e do Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF) sobre as condições de saúde da ex-deputada (como quadros de fibromialgia e desmaios) e o tratamento que ela receberia no sistema prisional no Brasil.
Esses novos dados já foram fornecidos, o que permite a reavaliação do caso.
A nova audiência na Itália foi marcada para 29 de outubro, após o segundo turno das eleições presidenciais no Brasil. A decisão não trata da culpa ou da inocência de Zambelli nem reavalia a condenação imposta pela Justiça brasileira.
No procedimento de extradição, cabe à Corte italiana apenas verificar se o pedido cumpre os requisitos previstos na legislação e nos tratados internacionais para que a entrega da acusada seja autorizada.
As condenações da ex-deputada
Luan Araújo foi perseguido por Carla Zambelli — Foto: Reprodução
Por 9 votos a 2, Zambelli foi condenada a 5 anos e 3 meses de prisão por porte ilegal de arma de fogo e constrangimento ilegal.
O episódio ocorreu na véspera do segundo turno das eleições de 2022. Na ocasião, a então deputada perseguiu, armada, um homem pelas ruas do bairro Jardins, em São Paulo (SP), após uma discussão política.
Em maio, a Corte Suprema de Cassação da Itália rejeitou a extradição de Zambelli em outro caso, a condenação dela a 10 anos de prisão pela invasão dos sistemas do Conselho Nacional de Justiça (CNJ).
A Corte de Cassação afirmou que identificou "diversos elementos" capazes de gerar dúvidas sobre a imparcialidade objetiva do Supremo Tribunal Federal, que condenou Carla Zambelli.
Segundo os magistrados, Alexandre de Moraes acumulou diferentes funções ao longo do processo e atuou simultaneamente como integrante do colegiado julgador e como pessoa considerada prejudicada por um dos crimes atribuídos à deputada.
A deputada licenciada Carla Zambelli em imagem de 27 de agosto de 2025. — Foto: TV Globo

deduped_items.body_text:
A Polícia Civil de Sergipe abriu uma investigação para apurar um caso de injúria racial contra um atleta adolescente dentro do Centro de Desenvolvimento da CBF, na Barra dos Coqueiros. De acordo com o Boletim de Ocorrência registrado pelo professor da vítima, o jovem sofreu ofensas racistas proferidas pelo presidente da equipe adversária ao fim de uma partida de futebol de base. O episódio foi presenciado pelo árbitro do jogo, que relatou o ocorrido na súmula.
Em nota, a Federação Sergipana de Futebol (FSF) informou que tomou conhecimento do caso e determinou a proibição da entrada do suspeito nas dependências do Centro de Desenvolvimento até o encerramento das apurações. A entidade ressaltou que a competição se tratava de um evento privado e que não realizou o gerenciamento do torneio.
Por fim, a FSF prestou solidariedade ao atleta e a seus familiares, reafirmou repúdio a qualquer ato de discriminação e declarou que o futebol deve ser um ambiente de respeito e inclusão, destacando o combate ao racismo como um compromisso inegociável da instituição.

deduped_items.title: Justiça italiana marca para o fim de outubro novo julgamento sobre extradição de Zambelli
deduped_items.summary: A justiça italiana marcou para o fim de outubro uma nova audiência para reavaliar o pedido de extradição da ex-deputada Carla Zambelli (PL-SP) para cumprir a pena pela condenação no caso da perseguição armada contra um homem pelas ruas de São Paulo. Em julho, a Justiça da Itália anulou a extradição e determinou que o pedido apresentado pelo Brasil seja submetido a um novo julgamento, voltando à fase inicial. A Justiça da Itália descartou a tese de perseguição política, que foi alegada pela defes
deduped_items.body_text:
A justiça italiana marcou para o fim de outubro uma nova audiência para reavaliar o pedido de extradição da ex-deputada Carla Zambelli (PL-SP) para cumprir a pena pela condenação no caso da perseguição armada contra um homem pelas ruas de São Paulo.
Em julho, a Justiça da Itália anulou a extradição e determinou que o pedido apresentado pelo Brasil seja submetido a um novo julgamento, voltando à fase inicial.
A Justiça da Itália descartou a tese de perseguição política, que foi alegada pela defesa de Zambelli. Mas entendeu ser necessária a apresentação de mais garantias do governo brasileiro e do Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF) sobre as condições de saúde da ex-deputada (como quadros de fibromialgia e desmaios) e o tratamento que ela receberia no sistema prisional no Brasil.
Esses novos dados já foram fornecidos, o que permite a reavaliação do caso.
A nova audiência na Itália foi marcada para 29 de outubro, após o segundo turno das eleições presidenciais no Brasil. A decisão não trata da culpa ou da inocência de Zambelli nem reavalia a condenação imposta pela Justiça brasileira.
No procedimento de extradição, cabe à Corte italiana apenas verificar se o pedido cumpre os requisitos previstos na legislação e nos tratados internacionais para que a entrega da acusada seja autorizada.
As condenações da ex-deputada
Luan Araújo foi perseguido por Carla Zambelli — Foto: Reprodução
Por 9 votos a 2, Zambelli foi condenada a 5 anos e 3 meses de prisão por porte ilegal de arma de fogo e constrangimento ilegal.
O episódio ocorreu na véspera do segundo turno das eleições de 2022. Na ocasião, a então deputada perseguiu, armada, um homem pelas ruas do bairro Jardins, em São Paulo (SP), após uma discussão política.
Em maio, a Corte Suprema de Cassação da Itália rejeitou a extradição de Zambelli em outro caso, a condenação dela a 10 anos de prisão pela invasão dos sistemas do Conselho Nacional de Justiça (CNJ).
A Corte de Cassação afirmou que identificou "diversos elementos" capazes de gerar dúvidas sobre a imparcialidade objetiva do Supremo Tribunal Federal, que condenou Carla Zambelli.
Segundo os magistrados, Alexandre de Moraes acumulou diferentes funções ao longo do processo e atuou simultaneamente como integrante do colegiado julgador e como pessoa considerada prejudicada por um dos crimes atribuídos à deputada.
A deputada licenciada Carla Zambelli em imagem de 27 de agosto de 2025. — Foto: TV Globo

deduped_items.title: Justiça italiana marca para o fim de outubro novo julgamento sobre extradição de Zambelli
deduped_items.summary: A justiça italiana marcou para o fim de outubro uma nova audiência para reavaliar o pedido de extradição da ex-deputada Carla Zambelli (PL-SP) para cumprir a pena pela condenação no caso da perseguição armada contra um homem pelas ruas de São Paulo. Em julho, a Justiça da Itália anulou a extradição e determinou que o pedido apresentado pelo Brasil seja submetido a um novo julgamento, voltando à fase inicial. A Justiça da Itália descartou a tese de perseguição política, que foi alegada pela defes
deduped_items.body_text:
A justiça italiana marcou para o fim de outubro uma nova audiência para reavaliar o pedido de extradição da ex-deputada Carla Zambelli (PL-SP) para cumprir a pena pela condenação no caso da perseguição armada contra um homem pelas ruas de São Paulo.
Em julho, a Justiça da Itália anulou a extradição e determinou que o pedido apresentado pelo Brasil seja submetido a um novo julgamento, voltando à fase inicial.
A Justiça da Itália descartou a tese de perseguição política, que foi alegada pela defesa de Zambelli. Mas entendeu ser necessária a apresentação de mais garantias do governo brasileiro e do Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF) sobre as condições de saúde da ex-deputada (como quadros de fibromialgia e desmaios) e o tratamento que ela receberia no sistema prisional no Brasil.
Esses novos dados já foram fornecidos, o que permite a reavaliação do caso.
A nova audiência na Itália foi marcada para 29 de outubro, após o segundo turno das eleições presidenciais no Brasil. A decisão não trata da culpa ou da inocência de Zambelli nem reavalia a condenação imposta pela Justiça brasileira.
No procedimento de extradição, cabe à Corte italiana apenas verificar se o pedido cumpre os requisitos previstos na legislação e nos tratados internacionais para que a entrega da acusada seja autorizada.
As condenações da ex-deputada
Luan Araújo foi perseguido por Carla Zambelli — Foto: Reprodução
Por 9 votos a 2, Zambelli foi condenada a 5 anos e 3 meses de prisão por porte ilegal de arma de fogo e constrangimento ilegal.
O episódio ocorreu na véspera do segundo turno das eleições de 2022. Na ocasião, a então deputada perseguiu, armada, um homem pelas ruas do bairro Jardins, em São Paulo (SP), após uma discussão política.
Em maio, a Corte Suprema de Cassação da Itália rejeitou a extradição de Zambelli em outro caso, a condenação dela a 10 anos de prisão pela invasão dos sistemas do Conselho Nacional de Justiça (CNJ).
A Corte de Cassação afirmou que identificou "diversos elementos" capazes de gerar dúvidas sobre a imparcialidade objetiva do Supremo Tribunal Federal, que condenou Carla Zambelli.
Segundo os magistrados, Alexandre de Moraes acumulou diferentes funções ao longo do processo e atuou simultaneamente como integrante do colegiado julgador e como pessoa considerada prejudicada por um dos crimes atribuídos à deputada.
A deputada licenciada Carla Zambelli em imagem de 27 de agosto de 2025. — Foto: TV Globo

deduped_items.title: Impor sanções ao Tribunal Penal Internacional é algo novo e perigoso para o multilateralismo
deduped_items.summary: A jurista sul-africana Navi Pillay, ex-juíza do TPI (Tribunal Penal Internacional), ganhou nesta sexta-feira (9) o Nobel da Paz. O próprio tribunal, ao lado da Corte Internacional de Justiça, estava entre os nomes cotados pelo Instituto de Pesquisa da Paz de Oslo. O prêmio reconhece uma trajetória de combate à impunidade, construída dentro e fora dos tribunais. Reforça o direito e, com ele, uma ideia de multilateralismo hoje contestada. Leia mais (10/09/2026 - 23h00)

deduped_items.title: Abbas postpones Palestinian elections, sets presidential poll for September 2027
deduped_items.summary: RAMALLAH, Oct 10 - Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas on Saturday cancelled legislative elections scheduled for November due to worsening conditions within the Palestinian territories and set a date of September 11, 2027 for both presidential and legislative elections, the official Palestinian news agency WAFA reported.
deduped_items.body_text:
Abbas postpones Palestinian elections, sets presidential poll for September 2027
RAMALLAH, Oct 10 - Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas on Saturday cancelled legislative elections scheduled for November due to worsening conditions within the Palestinian territories and set a date of September 11, 2027 for both presidential and legislative elections, the official Palestinian news agency WAFA reported.
Abbas' decree cited "obstacles posed by Israeli measures" to holding elections in November and the need to establish suitable political, security and on-the-ground conditions for "free, fair and inclusive elections". It called on Palestinians in Jerusalem, the West Bank and Gaza to participate in the polls.
There had been serious doubts that the Palestinian Authority vote would go ahead in late November. The Palestinians have not held legislative or presidential elections since 2005-06, after which Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas' rival, the Islamist group Hamas, seized control of Gaza, ousting his loyalists.
The decree said Israeli military attacks, settlement expansion, settler violence and movement restrictions in the West Bank, including East Jerusalem, along with Israel's continued withholding of Palestinian tax revenues, created challenges to preparing for and holding elections on the previous date.
In Gaza, the decree pointed to "exceptional security and humanitarian conditions", the incomplete withdrawal of Israeli forces, the lack of progress in reconstruction and the failure to implement arrangements for deploying international stabilisation forces and police.
Israeli restrictions on access for election commission staff and international observers to Gaza and East Jerusalem also complicated preparations, the decree said.
The decision to postpone followed a resolution by the Palestine Liberation Organisation's executive committee and consultations with Palestinian factions and political forces. It also aimed to allow time for a comprehensive Palestinian national dialogue to strengthen unity and address challenges facing the electoral process. REUTERS

deduped_items.title: ICJ judge Navi Pillay wins Nobel peace prize for promoting international law
deduped_items.summary: Committee recognises work of South African who chaired UN commission that concluded Israel was guilty of genocide in GazaThe Nobel peace prize has been awarded to Navi Pillay, the South African former UN human rights chief who chaired the UN commission that concluded Israel was guilty of genocide in Gaza.The Norwegian Nobel committee said Pillay, who is serving as a judge at the international court of justice (ICJ), has “shown that legal measures can help prevent acts of war and violence”. Conti
deduped_items.body_text:
The Nobel peace prize has been awarded to Navi Pillay, the South African former UN human rights chief who chaired the UN commission that concluded Israel was guilty of genocide in Gaza.
The Norwegian Nobel committee said Pillay, who is serving as a judge at the international court of justice (ICJ), has “shown that legal measures can help prevent acts of war and violence”.
“Navi Pillay’s commitment to universal legal principles and her firm moral compass are constants in a long career,” the committee said, mentioning her early work defending Nelson Mandela under South Africa’s apartheid regime, serving on the international criminal tribunal, and then as the UN high commissioner for human rights, as well as chairing the UN independent international commission of inquiry on the occupied Palestinian territory.
That commission concluded last year that the state of Israel was guilty of genocidal acts in Gaza “with the specific intent to destroy Palestinians in Gaza”, and said the country’s prime minister, Benjamin Netanyahu, its president, Isaac Herzog, and its former defence minister Yoav Gallant had “incited the commission of genocide”.
“It is clear that there is an intent to destroy the Palestinians in Gaza through acts that meet the criteria set forth in the genocide convention,” Pillay said on the publication of the commission’s findings in September last year.
Israel refused to cooperate with the commission, arguing it was biased, and rejected its report as “scandalous”. The Israeli foreign ministry reacted furiously to news of Pillay’s award on Friday.
“If there were an award for lies, hatred, and blood libels, Navi Pillay wouldn’t just be a contender. She’d be a frontrunner,” the ministry said on X, adding: “Awarding Pillay the Nobel Peace Prize isn’t a recognition of justice. It’s the grotesque weaponization of an award to legitimize anti-Israel hatred and prejudice.
“Now that the Nobel commission has rewarded the biggest lie of the 21st century, Joseph Goebbels is certainly applauding from hell.”
In its statement, the Nobel committee said Pillay, 85, had “contributed to strengthen the institutions of international law”.
“Her independence, expertise and steadfastness have made her one of the most respected international jurists of our time,” the committee said.
“In awarding this year’s Nobel peace prize, the Norwegian Nobel committee wants to remind the world that the rule of law – national and international – underpins the system we have set up to ensure peace and resolve conflicts non-violently,” its statement said.
The committee said it had not been able to locate Pillay before its announcement on Friday morning. She was attending a meeting of human rights lawyers and jurists in Nuremberg, Germany, at the site of postwar war crimes trials of Nazi leaders, and heard the news from colleagues. She responded with disbelief.
“I don’t know about it so much. The question is: is it true? Being a lawyer and a judge, I still want to verify it,” she said.
“The last thing I did was the report on Gaza naming what’s happening there as genocide,” Pillay added. “One of the main reactions to that report was people [complimented] me for my courage. You can imagine how surprised I was. Why would you need courage to speak the truth. You interpret the law. You look at all the facts, so it’s an impartial decision.”
Pillay is currently overseeing a genocide case against Myanmar at the ICJ.
The ICJ, a UN body, rules on disputes between states, while the international criminal court (ICC) investigates and prosecutes individuals accused of atrocities and other grave international crimes.

deduped_items.body_text:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif on Saturday had a telephone call with Jamiat Ulema-i-Islam—Fazl (JUI-F) chief Maulana Fazlur Rehman, with reducing tensions between the Centre and the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa government among the topics discussed.
According to a statement from the Prime Minister’s Office (PMO), PM Shehbaz congratulated the JUI-F leader on performing Umrah and extended an invitation for talks at the Prime Minister’s House.
“Maulana Fazlur Rehman accepted the prime minister’s invitation [and] the meeting is expected to take place soon,” the statement read.
The phone call follows recent contacts between Fazl, known for his engagement with politicians from across the board, and the opposition.
The Oct 3 talks held to bridge differences between the Centre and the opposition alliance Tehreek-i-Tahafuz-i-Ayin-i-Pakistan (TTAP) failed due to multiple reasons, particularly the counterterrorism policy.
On Tuesday, TTAP leaders called on Fazl at his residence, following which the veteran politician advised the federal government not to obstruct the PTI long march heading towards Islamabad, as protests were a democratic right enjoyed by all political parties.
The next day, PM’s Adviser on Political Affairs Rana Sanaullah, Parliamentary Affairs Minister Tariq Fazal Chaudhry and National Assembly Speaker Ayaz Sadiq met the JUI-F chief.
On Thursday, PTI MNA Junaid Akbar confirmed that Fazl had offered to play a role in ending the deadlock between the government and opposition, adding that the PTI’s “doors are open” to it.
Speaking on Geo News, Akbar had said no framework had been put forward by Fazl regarding his role in the negotiations, although he noted that the JUI-F chief had been in touch with PTI leadership while he was away for Umrah.
The same day, Defence Minister Khawaja Asif also hinted at efforts to restart negotiations between the Centre and the opposition, saying, “I wish a positive result comes out of the efforts of those involved in the talks. But, I have little hope.”
Speaking to Dawn, JUI-F spokesman Aslam Ghauri said his party chief was playing the role of a “facilitator, not a mediator”.
He distinguished the two roles by saying that a mediator would have the authority from opposition parties to make his own decision in light of their demands.
“It is our (JUI-F’s) priority to bring both sides on table for resumption of talks,” he added, pointing out that they had urged the government to call a multi-party conference in Parliament House, where political and security issues should be discussed.
The JUI-F leader said sitting at the table would benefit both sides, though the resumption of dialogue would mostly benefit the PTI because the KP government is “virtually being run by someone else and not by Chief Minister Sohail Afridi”.
PM meets president
Separately, PM Shehbaz also met with President Asif Ali Zardari, with the country’s overall security and political situation coming under discussion, according to an official handout.
The premier was accompanied by Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar, Adviser to the Prime Minister on Political Affairs Rana Sanaullah, Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi, Attorney General Mansoor Usman Awan and Law Minister Azam Nazeer Tarar.
“It was agreed during the meeting to convene separate sessions of the National Assembly and the Senate on Tuesday (Oct 13),” the statement said.
Heightened tensions between Centre, PTI
The PML-N-led federal government and the KP government led by PTI — which is in opposition in the Centre — have been at odds over various issues, particularly on the counterterrorism policy.
The PTI has said it was being left out of security decisions concerning KP, which the Centre has denied. It also calls for reviewing the counterterrorism policy, while the latter criticises the KP government’s efforts to combat terrorism in the province and objects to its stance on dialogue with the Afghan Taliban.
In recent days, federal ministers have assailed the PTI fo

deduped_items.title: Govt assails PTI over 'lack of governance' in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
deduped_items.summary: Information Minister Attaullah Tarar on Saturday assailed the PTI-led Khyber Pakhtunkhwa government over a “lack of governance” in the province. Addressing a press conference in Islamabad, he alleged that the provincial government was given Rs700 billion under the National Finance Commission for development projects. “You did not upgrade the Counter Terrorism Department (CTD), did not establish forensic labs, did not install safe city cameras, which should be installed in the merged districts an
deduped_items.body_text:
Information Minister Attaullah Tarar on Saturday assailed the PTI-led Khyber Pakhtunkhwa government over a “lack of governance” in the province.
Addressing a press conference in Islamabad, he alleged that the provincial government was given Rs700 billion under the National Finance Commission for development projects.
“You did not upgrade the Counter Terrorism Department (CTD), did not establish forensic labs, did not install safe city cameras, which should be installed in the merged districts and all the entry-exit points of KP’s districts,” he alleged.
On the other hand, the information minister claimed that the PTI was spending this money on organising protests.
“You don’t even give half an hour to discuss terrorism in the province, but you organise six-hour meetings to spread turmoil and vandalism,” he criticised.
Tarar further said that the PTI had “trapped” millions of people in the province to get its leader, former prime minister Imran Khan, released from jail.
“You trapped them in poverty, in disease by not providing the adequate health facilities, in ignorance by not providing educational opportunities, and in non-development by not improving infrastructure,” he said.
Tarar also alleged that the KP government had held the people of the province “captive to terrorists”.
“From the very first day, this is my opinion that they [PTI] are the B-team of the Tehreek-i-Taliban Pakistan,” Tarar said.
The information minister said that the PTI facilitated terrorists in settling in the country.
“For how long will it go on? That the security forces will clear the area of terrorists and establish peace, but you will bring the terrorists back?” he asked.
During his address, Tarar said that the PTI government in KP had dragged the province into the “stone age” during the last 13 and a half years.
Citing various federal government projects, Tarar maintained that there was no comparison of the hours spent working by Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif and KP Chief Minister Sohail Afridi to address governance issues and take relief and reform measures.
He said that the chief ministers of all the provinces were working hard, questioning how many hours Afridi spent on governance.
“Tell us if you have ever given a big hospital, a university, a highway to your people, an information technology project to the youth of KP or given them laptops or gadgets,” he said.
“How long can such a system, where there is chaos and extremist politics, continue?” he asked.
He claimed that the KP government wanted to hand over the province to terrorists as it prioritised “personal interests over the national interests”.
“This province needs peace, not politics,” Tarar stated.
Asked about imposing an emergency or governor’s rule in KP, Tarar said that responding to this question would be premature.
“Everyone is asking how long KP and its people will remain at the mercy of its government,” he said.
“In my opinion, the conditions in KP have never been worse. They could not be worse than this. What’s worse than terrorists roaming in the streets? You have designated no-go areas in most of your districts because you collect ransom in collusion with terrorists,” he claimed.
He said that the people of KP go to Punjab or other provinces for medical treatment.
“Will there ever come a time when people from across Pakistan go to KP for treatment?” he asked. The information minister asserted that the PTI would not be allowed to destroy the province.
Addressing the same press conference, Coordinator to the Prime Minister on Information for KP Affairs Ikhtiar Wali Khan also questioned the lack of development in the province.
“Universities are shutting down because there are no vice chancellors there. Eighteen out of 34 universities in KP are on the verge of bankruptcy,” he said.
Wali said that people complained about the lack of good roads in Karachi. “But when people of KP go to Karachi, they say that Karachi’s roads are much better than KP.”

deduped_items.title: Pakistan reaffirms commitment to Saudi security at UN Security Council
deduped_items.summary: UNITED NATIONS: Pakistan has reaffirmed its commitment to Saudi Arabia’s sovereignty, territorial integrity and security at the United Nations Security Council (UNSC), declaring that it would stand “shoulder to shoulder” with the kingdom in the face of continued Houthi attacks. deduped_items.body_text:
UNITED NATIONS: Pakistan has reaffirmed its commitment to Saudi Arabia’s sovereignty, territorial integrity and security at the United Nations Security Council (UNSC), declaring that it would stand “shoulder to shoulder” with the kingdom in the face of continued Houthi attacks.
Addressing the UNSC’s monthly briefing on Yemen on Friday evening, Pakistan’s Permanent Representative to the UN, Ambassador Asim Iftikhar Ahmad, condemned attacks on Saudi Arabia and called for an immediate end to the hostilities, invoking the Makkah Joint Defence Agreement and recent decisions of its Strategic Political and Defence Committee.
“In line with the Makkah Joint Defence Agreement, and recent decisions taken by its Strategic Political and Defence Committee, our commitment to the Kingdom’s sovereignty, territorial integrity and security is resolute,” Ambassador Ahmad said, quoting Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif’s statement issued the previous day.
He said Pakistan fully supported Saudi Arabia’s legitimate right to defend its people and protect its cities and vital infrastructure.
The ambassador condemned Houthi attacks targeting infrastructure in the Makkah Governorate and the Taibah power distribution station in Madinah. He also recalled Pakistan’s condemnation of attacks on King Khalid International Airport and Abha International Airport that resulted in civilian deaths and injuries.
“The Houthi militia must immediately cease these attacks,” he said, reiterating Pakistan’s solidarity with the Saudi leadership and people.
“The security and sanctity of the Two Holy Mosques must be respected at all times,” the statement quoted the prime minister as saying.
Beyond the security of Saudi Arabia, Ambassador Ahmad reaffirmed Pakistan’s support for Yemen’s sovereignty, independence, unity and territorial integrity, as well as its internationally recognised government.
He warned that the intensifying Houthi offensive along Yemen’s western coast and around the Bab el-Mandeb Strait underscored the urgency of protecting maritime security. The envoy called on the Houthis to cease attacks on commercial shipping and urged that freedom of navigation be upheld in accordance with international law.
The ambassador also expressed support for UN Special Envoy Hans Grundberg’s efforts to contain the escalation, maintain communication and facilitate a cessation of hostilities. He called for an inclusive, Yemeni-led and Yemeni-owned political process under UN auspices.
Addressing the worsening humanitarian situation, Ambassador Ahmad said renewed fighting, including the offensive around Taiz and the attack by Houthi elements on Aden airport, had further exposed civilians and essential infrastructure to danger.
He called for safe, rapid and unhindered humanitarian access, adequate funding for relief operations and the protection of civilian infrastructure. Food, fuel and essential commercial supplies, he stressed, must reach all those in need.
Pakistan also reiterated its call for the immediate, unconditional and safe release of detained UN, humanitarian and diplomatic personnel.
“The council must act with unity and purpose to halt Houthi attacks, safeguard regional security, alleviate suffering and restore a credible path towards a political settlement,” Ambassador Ahmad said.
Pakistan, he added, would continue to support efforts towards a peaceful, stable and united Yemen and work to advance lasting peace and stability in the region.

deduped_items.body_text:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif on Saturday had a telephone call with Jamiat Ulema-i-Islam—Fazl (JUI-F) chief Maulana Fazlur Rehman, with reducing tensions between the Centre and the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa government among the topics discussed.
According to a statement from the Prime Minister’s Office (PMO), PM Shehbaz congratulated the JUI-F leader on performing Umrah and extended an invitation for talks at the Prime Minister’s House.
“Maulana Fazlur Rehman accepted the prime minister’s invitation [and] the meeting is expected to take place soon,” the statement read.
The phone call follows recent contacts between Fazl, known for his engagement with politicians from across the board, and the opposition.
The Oct 3 talks held to bridge differences between the Centre and the opposition alliance Tehreek-i-Tahafuz-i-Ayin-i-Pakistan (TTAP) failed due to multiple reasons, particularly the counterterrorism policy.
On Tuesday, TTAP leaders called on Fazl at his residence, following which the veteran politician advised the federal government not to obstruct the PTI long march heading towards Islamabad, as protests were a democratic right enjoyed by all political parties.
The next day, PM’s Adviser on Political Affairs Rana Sanaullah, Parliamentary Affairs Minister Tariq Fazal Chaudhry and National Assembly Speaker Ayaz Sadiq met the JUI-F chief.
On Thursday, PTI MNA Junaid Akbar confirmed that Fazl had offered to play a role in ending the deadlock between the government and opposition, adding that the PTI’s “doors are open” to it.
Speaking on Geo News, Akbar had said no framework had been put forward by Fazl regarding his role in the negotiations, although he noted that the JUI-F chief had been in touch with PTI leadership while he was away for Umrah.
The same day, Defence Minister Khawaja Asif also hinted at efforts to restart negotiations between the Centre and the opposition, saying, “I wish a positive result comes out of the efforts of those involved in the talks. But, I have little hope.”
Speaking to Dawn, JUI-F spokesman Aslam Ghauri said his party chief was playing the role of a “facilitator, not a mediator”.
He distinguished the two roles by saying that a mediator would have the authority from opposition parties to make his own decision in light of their demands.
“It is our (JUI-F’s) priority to bring both sides on table for resumption of talks,” he added, pointing out that they had urged the government to call a multi-party conference in Parliament House, where political and security issues should be discussed.
The JUI-F leader said sitting at the table would benefit both sides, though the resumption of dialogue would mostly benefit the PTI because the KP government is “virtually being run by someone else and not by Chief Minister Sohail Afridi”.
PM meets president
Separately, PM Shehbaz also met with President Asif Ali Zardari, with the country’s overall security and political situation coming under discussion, according to an official handout.
The premier was accompanied by Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar, Adviser to the Prime Minister on Political Affairs Rana Sanaullah, Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi, Attorney General Mansoor Usman Awan and Law Minister Azam Nazeer Tarar.
“It was agreed during the meeting to convene separate sessions of the National Assembly and the Senate on Tuesday (Oct 13),” the statement said.
Heightened tensions between Centre, PTI
The PML-N-led federal government and the KP government led by PTI — which is in opposition in the Centre — have been at odds over various issues, particularly on the counterterrorism policy.
The PTI has said it was being left out of security decisions concerning KP, which the Centre has denied. It also calls for reviewing the counterterrorism policy, while the latter criticises the KP government’s efforts to combat terrorism in the province and objects to its stance on dialogue with the Afghan Taliban.

deduped_items.normalised_title: pm shehbaz fazl speak on reducing tensions between federal kp govts

deduped_items.title: Alcaraz through in straight sets on Shanghai Masters opener
deduped_items.body_text:
Alcaraz through in straight sets on Shanghai Masters opener
- By AFP -
- Oct 10, 2026
A moustached Carlos Alcaraz beat Juan Manuel Cerundolo 6-3, 6-3 to kick-start his title bid at the Shanghai Masters on Saturday, days after winning the Tokyo Open for his first trophy since returning from injury.
The Spanish star, seeded second, put on a dominant show to brush aside the 55th-ranked Argentinian in the second round in just 66 minutes.
“Really, really happy with the way I played today. It wasn’t easy,” said the 23-year-old former number one.
“Just had two days of preparation… I came from Tokyo, there were totally different conditions,” he added. “Just tried to play the best that I can.”
Sporting a fresh moustache, Alcaraz signed a camera “Moustache Team” following his win.
Asked by an on-court interviewer about the new look, Alcaraz said: “It’s gonna stay.”
He will play either Ignacio Buse or Zizou Bergs in the next round.
Earlier, Daniil Medvedev fought back to beat Germany’s Jan-Lennard Struff 4-6, 6-4, 6-3 in the second round, the Russian’s first match since being disqualified from the China Open.
Medvedev was defaulted from his semi-final against Novak Djokovic in Beijing for hitting a spectator with a ball and ended the 500-level event with zero ranking points and no prize money.
The former world number one said it was an accident.
Playing five days later in Shanghai, sixth-ranked Medvedev overcame an early wobble to hold off 59th-ranked Struff.
He sent down 21 aces to advance and will face Czech qualifier Dalibor Svrcina in the next round.
World number five Felix Auger-Aliassime also survived a scare, needing three hours to beat 77th-ranked Camilo Ugo Carabelli 4-6, 7-6 (7/1), 7-5.
The Canadian will play Spaniard Pablo Carreno Busta in the third round.
Several matches in the afternoon were suspended due to rain, but Taylor Fritz, Casper Ruud and Arthur Fils all went through as play resumed.

deduped_items.title: Abbas postpones Palestinian elections, sets presidential poll for September 2027
deduped_items.summary: RAMALLAH, Oct 10 - Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas on Saturday cancelled legislative elections scheduled for November due to worsening conditions within the Palestinian territories and set a date of September 11, 2027 for both presidential and legislative elections, the official Palestinian news agency WAFA reported.
deduped_items.body_text:
Abbas postpones Palestinian elections, sets presidential poll for September 2027
RAMALLAH, Oct 10 - Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas on Saturday cancelled legislative elections scheduled for November due to worsening conditions within the Palestinian territories and set a date of September 11, 2027 for both presidential and legislative elections, the official Palestinian news agency WAFA reported.
Abbas' decree cited "obstacles posed by Israeli measures" to holding elections in November and the need to establish suitable political, security and on-the-ground conditions for "free, fair and inclusive elections". It called on Palestinians in Jerusalem, the West Bank and Gaza to participate in the polls.
There had been serious doubts that the Palestinian Authority vote would go ahead in late November. The Palestinians have not held legislative or presidential elections since 2005-06, after which Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas' rival, the Islamist group Hamas, seized control of Gaza, ousting his loyalists.
The decree said Israeli military attacks, settlement expansion, settler violence and movement restrictions in the West Bank, including East Jerusalem, along with Israel's continued withholding of Palestinian tax revenues, created challenges to preparing for and holding elections on the previous date.
In Gaza, the decree pointed to "exceptional security and humanitarian conditions", the incomplete withdrawal of Israeli forces, the lack of progress in reconstruction and the failure to implement arrangements for deploying international stabilisation forces and police.
Israeli restrictions on access for election commission staff and international observers to Gaza and East Jerusalem also complicated preparations, the decree said.
The decision to postpone followed a resolution by the Palestine Liberation Organisation's executive committee and consultations with Palestinian factions and political forces. It also aimed to allow time for a comprehensive Palestinian national dialogue to strengthen unity and address challenges facing the electoral process. REUTERS

deduped_items.body_text:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif on Saturday had a telephone call with Jamiat Ulema-i-Islam—Fazl (JUI-F) chief Maulana Fazlur Rehman, with reducing tensions between the Centre and the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa government among the topics discussed.
According to a statement from the Prime Minister’s Office (PMO), PM Shehbaz congratulated the JUI-F leader on performing Umrah and extended an invitation for talks at the Prime Minister’s House.
“Maulana Fazlur Rehman accepted the prime minister’s invitation [and] the meeting is expected to take place soon,” the statement read.
The phone call follows recent contacts between Fazl, known for his engagement with politicians from across the board, and the opposition.
The Oct 3 talks held to bridge differences between the Centre and the opposition alliance Tehreek-i-Tahafuz-i-Ayin-i-Pakistan (TTAP) failed due to multiple reasons, particularly the counterterrorism policy.
On Tuesday, TTAP leaders called on Fazl at his residence, following which the veteran politician advised the federal government not to obstruct the PTI long march heading towards Islamabad, as protests were a democratic right enjoyed by all political parties.
The next day, PM’s Adviser on Political Affairs Rana Sanaullah, Parliamentary Affairs Minister Tariq Fazal Chaudhry and National Assembly Speaker Ayaz Sadiq met the JUI-F chief.
On Thursday, PTI MNA Junaid Akbar confirmed that Fazl had offered to play a role in ending the deadlock between the government and opposition, adding that the PTI’s “doors are open” to it.
Speaking on Geo News, Akbar had said no framework had been put forward by Fazl regarding his role in the negotiations, although he noted that the JUI-F chief had been in touch with PTI leadership while he was away for Umrah.
The same day, Defence Minister Khawaja Asif also hinted at efforts to restart negotiations between the Centre and the opposition, saying, “I wish a positive result comes out of the efforts of those involved in the talks. But, I have little hope.”
Speaking to Dawn, JUI-F spokesman Aslam Ghauri said his party chief was playing the role of a “facilitator, not a mediator”.
He distinguished the two roles by saying that a mediator would have the authority from opposition parties to make his own decision in light of their demands.
“It is our (JUI-F’s) priority to bring both sides on table for resumption of talks,” he added, pointing out that they had urged the government to call a multi-party conference in Parliament House, where political and security issues should be discussed.
The JUI-F leader said sitting at the table would benefit both sides, though the resumption of dialogue would mostly benefit the PTI because the KP government is “virtually being run by someone else and not by Chief Minister Sohail Afridi”.
PM meets president
Separately, PM Shehbaz also met with President Asif Ali Zardari, with the country’s overall security and political situation coming under discussion, according to an official handout.
The premier was accompanied by Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar, Adviser to the Prime Minister on Political Affairs Rana Sanaullah, Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi, Attorney General Mansoor Usman Awan and Law Minister Azam Nazeer Tarar.
“It was agreed during the meeting to convene separate sessions of the National Assembly and the Senate on Tuesday (Oct 13),” the statement said.
Heightened tensions between Centre, PTI
The PML-N-led federal government and the KP government led by PTI — which is in opposition in the Centre — have been at odds over various issues, particularly on the counterterrorism policy.
The PTI has said it was being left out of security decisions concerning KP, which the Centre has denied. deduped_items.title: Abbas postpones Palestinian elections, sets presidential poll for September 2027
deduped_items.summary: RAMALLAH, Oct 10 - Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas on Saturday cancelled legislative elections scheduled for November due to worsening conditions within the Palestinian territories and set a date of September 11, 2027 for both presidential and legislative elections, the official Palestinian news agency WAFA reported.
deduped_items.body_text:
Abbas postpones Palestinian elections, sets presidential poll for September 2027
RAMALLAH, Oct 10 - Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas on Saturday cancelled legislative elections scheduled for November due to worsening conditions within the Palestinian territories and set a date of September 11, 2027 for both presidential and legislative elections, the official Palestinian news agency WAFA reported.
Abbas' decree cited "obstacles posed by Israeli measures" to holding elections in November and the need to establish suitable political, security and on-the-ground conditions for "free, fair and inclusive elections". It called on Palestinians in Jerusalem, the West Bank and Gaza to participate in the polls.
There had been serious doubts that the Palestinian Authority vote would go ahead in late November. The Palestinians have not held legislative or presidential elections since 2005-06, after which Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas' rival, the Islamist group Hamas, seized control of Gaza, ousting his loyalists.
The decree said Israeli military attacks, settlement expansion, settler violence and movement restrictions in the West Bank, including East Jerusalem, along with Israel's continued withholding of Palestinian tax revenues, created challenges to preparing for and holding elections on the previous date.
In Gaza, the decree pointed to "exceptional security and humanitarian conditions", the incomplete withdrawal of Israeli forces, the lack of progress in reconstruction and the failure to implement arrangements for deploying international stabilisation forces and police.
Israeli restrictions on access for election commission staff and international observers to Gaza and East Jerusalem also complicated preparations, the decree said.
The decision to postpone followed a resolution by the Palestine Liberation Organisation's executive committee and consultations with Palestinian factions and political forces. It also aimed to allow time for a comprehensive Palestinian national dialogue to strengthen unity and address challenges facing the electoral process. REUTERS

RSF preps new front from Ethiopia, pummels Blue Nile; In Kordofan, RSF conducts ‘field’ executions, digs in heels at Nuhud; Dagris prison dispute stalls registry; Gov’t criticizes UN fact-finding renewal          
With all eyes turned toward the escalating conflict in Ethiopia that is teetering on the brink of becoming a wider regional war, the Rapid Support Forces stepped up their attacks on the Sudan war’s southeastern front this week.
Blue Nile’s Wad al-Mahi locality in the east of the state bore the brunt of the escalation. The RSF launched an attack from Ethiopia on Saturday and seized the Kadalo mountains area, which sits near the Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam and Roseires Dam reservoir. This coincided with a drone campaign against Damazin, which included strikes on the homes of Blue Nile Governor Ahmed Badry and Regional Finance Minister Abbas Kara, fuel stations, military sites, universities and mosques.
The military has hit back, launching airstrikes on RSF positions in Wad al-Mahi and tried to reassure residents. As of Sunday, about 2,800 people are estimated to have been displaced from 10 villages in Wad al-Mahi.
But action in the southeastern front wasn’t limited to the Blue Nile. Large numbers of RSF fighters have been moved from Darfur to Addis Ababa in recent weeks in preparation to transfer them toward Sudan’s eastern border, where they are expected to gear up for an attack on the Fashaga border strip in Gadarif State, according to an RSF source and another source informed of the mobilization arrangements who spoke to Mada Masr.
In anticipation of escalating attacks on the border, the Sudanese military has reinforced its positions in the east, military sources tell Mada Masr. And on Wednesday, military chief and Transitional Sovereignty Council Chair Abdel Fattah al-Burhan visited the 11th Infantry Division in Khashm al-Gerba, Kassala State, which borders Gadarif to the north.
On the western front, the military is preparing to attack the remaining RSF-held areas in North Kordofan and advance into West Kordofan, with eyes set on Um Bader and Hamra al-Sheikh in northwestern North Kordofan. Meanwhile, the RSF is digging its heels in West Kordofan, with the group having dug trenches and built earth berms around the strategic city of Nuhud to guard against surprise attacks, an activist in the state told Mada Masr.
West Kordofan also saw yet another attack on an aid truck this week, with Khartoum laying blame for the strike at the feet of the RSF and the Sudan People’s Liberation Movement-North (Abdel Aziz al-Hilu faction).
In Um Bader, a social media video of the execution of 23 detainees is raising concern. While the RSF-led Tasis government tried to pin the executions on the military, three sources from the paramilitary group confirmed that the RSF had carried out the ‘field’ executions. As to why, the RSF sources’ accounts conflicted with those of medical sources and relatives of one of the men killed who spoke to Mada Masr. But both Tasis and officials in Khartoum are keen to pursue justice, even if a Tasis official continued to dismiss the RSF’s implications when presented with what sources from the paramilitary told Mada Masr.

The UN’s fact-finding committee on Sudan did get its mandate renewed, much to the chagrin of the government in Khartoum, which sees any form of international intervention as an infringement on its sovereignty.
